types.description: TeSys D contactor / 3-pole (3 NO) / AC-3 65 A up to 440 V / 230 V AC 50/60 Hz coil (P7) / 1 NO + 1 NC integral auxiliary

document.title: Schneider Electric / Telemecanique TeSys historical contactors catalogue, CERN-hosted manufacturer document

modelingNotes: Manufacturer spelling is LC1D65P7 (no separators); the source hyphen in LC1-D65P7 is a presentation separator. orderNumber keeps the job's expected LC1-D65P7.

Coil P7 = 230 V AC, 50/60 Hz (B8/8 a.c. supply table). Frequency is a 50/60 Hz range kept in notes, not as a scalar. Integral coil suppression is attributed by the catalogue to D115/D150 a.c. and to d.c. coils, not to this 230 V a.c. D65 coil; any suppression device would not add a terminal or a net.

No fixed internal continuity: the three main poles and aux 13-14 are switched normally-open contacts, aux 21-22 a switched normally-closed contact, A1/A2 a coil winding. actuates/ganged_with relations assert mechanical linkage only, not electrical continuity. No factory jumper.

Coordinator reviewed the exact historical LC1-D65•• row and P7 table in manufacturer TeSys catalogue 24501-EN_Ver6.0 p.24501/2 (physical 1), with the applicable LC1-D09–D150 circuit 24532/2 (physical 13). LC1-D65P7 is established directly; newer LC1D65A ratings/terminal hardware are not transferred. The historical row gives 65 A AC-3, 18.5 kW at 220/230 V, 30 kW at 380/400 V and 37 kW at 415/440/500 V. P7 is 230 VAC 50/60 Hz. Three NO main poles plus NO 13/NO–14 and NC 21/NC–22 auxiliary and A1/A2 coil; no built-in suppressor is specified for this historical AC D65. https://sy-dep-epc-lpc.web.cern.ch/components/datasheets/epc-lpc%20%28converters%29/LC1-D_Breaker%20Contactor_Telemecanique.pdf

connectionCoverage.notes: All 12 labeled circuit endpoints are represented. Physical duplicate-access/clamping positions and any accessory suppression attachment geometry are not separately enumerated for the historical hardware edition; connection coverage is partial for those details. No extra terminal or fixed link is inferred. Optional external accessories remain separate.
